guestPolicy: Guests may not stay more than three nights in any calendar month without written consent.
maintenanceResponsibility: Tenant is responsible for all repairs to the premises and appliances except structural repairs to the roof and foundation.
earlyTerminationPenalty: Tenant must pay an early termination fee equal to three months of rent plus rent owed through the date Landlord recovers possession.

otherMoneyTerms.name: Daily Late Fee
otherMoneyTerms.notes: Additional daily late charge until paid in full, up to a maximum of 450.00 total per month.

otherMoneyTerms.name: Unauthorized Occupant Fee
otherMoneyTerms.notes: Per day charge for unauthorized occupants.

otherMoneyTerms.name: Pet Rent
otherMoneyTerms.notes: Monthly fee per pet if approved.

rawNotes: Tenant waives liability claims against Landlord and must maintain renters insurance with at least 100,000 in liability coverage. Tenant agrees to pay Landlord's attorney fees in any dispute.
